The 90-96s turbo timings were measured at 3+5 and now need a re-measure.

UNRELEASED note added. 18 assertions + 34 tests green, eslint clean.

EasyCache gated off turbo in both graphs and synced (two bad exports caught at the diff step and discarded before install). Re-measured on the shipped shape: turbo 171.1s vs non-turbo 220.1s at 864x480/5s warm, n=2 each - ~22%, not the ~53% the brief claimed, because EasyCache skips 8/20 on the quality path and 0/8 under turbo. performance.md rewritten with the decomposition; release note reworded off "about half". EasyCache disproven for image models on Krea2 (0.45-0.49 per-step change vs H3 0.10-0.22).

EasyCache gate verified live: turbo runs print no EasyCache lines at all. Worth 171.07 -> 168.31s warm (~1.6%), not the ~6% first estimated - corrected in performance.md. Bigger finding: turbo changes MOTION, slower movement but no low-res morphing, where non-turbo is natural speed with substantial morphing. Speed is post-fixable, morphing is not, so turbo can be the better output at small sizes. Release copy reworded; observation recorded as not-yet-measured and must not move the default without a fixed-seed A/B.

Pod path safety checked: the baked backslashed turbo LoRA name is healed to / by comfyController ~L1438 for any non-Windows-local engine (MPI-141/198/229), which the comment calls out for BAKED values specifically. Verified on both shipped graphs, healed value equals the dep filename and is all-lowercase. Not proven: the weight being present on the Pod volume - that needs a smoke run, and is the last open item with the NOT LOADED check. Also split docs/models/h3/turbo.md out of performance.md (both now ~122 lines) and put the EasyCache-is-video-only verdict in docs/models/krea2/samplers.md.
